completion_evidence_contract.admission: Full161 source row + acquired complete gameY + final untied score + independent Final/REG CSV matching score identity + empty14 + no15/16. Empty14 alone is insufficient.
completion_evidence_contract.date_resolution: Calendar-day reconstruction under source game-log semantics; no invented UTC completion timestamp or claim of exact contemporaneous source version.
completion_evidence_contract.source_date: Retrosheet field1 actual played date; field14 specifies later-date completion from suspension/upheld protest.

features.baseline: 2024 annual net runs per game(home)-same(away), fixed throughout 2025; reuses sealed annual-source identity/chronology checks.
features.history_rules: Actual as-played date in final complete Retrosheet game log, independent Final/REG CSV and score identity agreement, field14 present in full161 contract and empty (no later-date completion), no forfeit/protest. All later-date or uncertain completion excluded. Postponement before first pitch is irrelevant; no original schedule needed.
features.single_added: 2025 admissible lagged wins(home)/games(home)-wins(away)/games(away); no smoothing, no windows or tuning.
features.standardization: Train-admitted rows only; per-feature mean/population SD, zero SD uses1, both models same training rows.

fit.solver: Fixed damped Newton, zero init, max100 iterations, max20 backtracking halves, Armijo1e-4, gradient infinity norm<=1e-8; no alternatives.

method_revision.decision: Remove never-postponed condition. Completed-as-played history is allowed even if postponed before first pitch; exclude later-date completion or uncertain actual completion. Frozen split/lag/minimum/features/lambda/rejection rule unchanged.

postponement_proof_contract.reason: Pre-first-pitch postponement does not change actual completed-as-played date used for seven-calendar-day lag. Explicit authorized method revision.

raw_field_documentation.field14: Later-date completion/suspension/upheld protest information, not original planned date or a postponement indicator.
raw_field_documentation.field161: Y means complete game information acquired; it is not an original scheduling assertion.

reject_rule: Reject if candidate accuracy<=baseline or candidate Brier>baseline or candidate logloss>baseline. Passing is only development, requires new data and same-game market validation.

split.algorithm: First sorted source date whose cumulative raw game count reaches ceil(0.60*N), train includes entire boundary date; evaluation strictly later. Dates/counts only, not labels or metrics.
